instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot. Inside a studio with a red carpet and white walls, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right. On the right, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) balances on his left leg while kicking his right leg forward towards her. The scene is brightly lit by overhead studio lights, with a printer and wooden floor visible in the background.
